registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act (Chap. 75:01); NIS, health surcharge' confirmed: personal allowance 90,000 (s. 18); 25 % to 1,000,000 of chargeable income, 30 % above; 70 % of NIS contributions deductible within a 60,000 cap (ss. 28(15), 31(1)(c)); health surcharge 8.25/4.80 a week; NIS employee one third of 13.2 % by weekly class (Table A9, unchanged since 5 Sep 2016 in the 2025 consolidation).
